76	+## Intent
77	+
78	+**Problem:** `EntryRecordCard` has no `onTap` at all — a user cannot open a single Entry to see its full content, and `GET /entries/:id` (RF07) is wired nowhere in the app.
79	+
80	+**Approach:** Add `EntriesRepository.getById`, a new `EntryDetailCubit`/`EntryDetailScreen` reached via a `/meus-registros/:id` route, and wire the record card's new `onTap` into it. The cubit composes auth status, the one shared sync-badge derivation, and the fetched Entry into its own sealed state — strictly read-only, no prototype precedent to match.
81	+
82	+## Boundaries & Constraints
83	+
84	+**Always:**
85	+- `EntriesRepository.getById(String id)` returns `Either<Failure, Entry>` — the repository's third and last method; `create`/`list` unchanged (AD-11: create+read only, forever).
86	+- Real call: `ApiClient.get('entries-get', pathParams: [id])`; decode with `EntryDto.fromJson` (its response is a superset, same as `create`/`list`'s DTO reuse).
87	+- `getById` persists the fetched entry to the `entries` Hive box (`put`) before returning `Right`, same "persist then return" ordering `create`/`list` already use. On `Failure.networkOffline`/`networkTimeout` specifically, falls back to `entriesBox.get(id)` if present; a cache miss propagates the original failure unchanged (no synthesized not-found).
88	+- `Failure.notFound` (and any other failure the cache doesn't absorb) renders one generic not-found treatment — identical whether the id never existed or belongs to another user (RNF04); never a distinguishable permission-denied state.
89	+- New `EntryDetailCubit` (factory-registered, mirrors the capture cubits' DI shape) combines exactly three sources into its own sealed `EntryDetailState` (mirrors `MeusRegistrosState`'s shape, never `Resource<T>`): `SessionRepository.statusStream`, `PendingEntryWriteTracker` feeding the existing `deriveSyncBadgeState()` (never recomputed inline), and one `getById` fetch — merged only inside this cubit; it never imports/reaches into `MeusRegistrosCubit` or any other Cubit (AD-7).
90	+- Screen renders content, source, local time, and a `SyncBadge` (no `onRetryTap` — a fetched Entry is always server-confirmed) — zero edit affordance anywhere on it.
91	+- `EntryRecordCard` gains a required `onTap`; `MeusRegistrosScreen` wires it to `context.push('${AppRoutePaths.meusRegistros}/${entry.id}')`. A pending/failed placeholder's synthetic `tempId` is a valid, un-special-cased navigation target — it simply 404s into the same generic not-found treatment as any other unknown id (RNF04 already covers this).
92	+- New `GoRoute` nested under `AppRoutePaths.meusRegistros` with a required `:id` segment; reuses the app's single `redirect` and `ExpiryOverlayHost` as-is (no new overlay, no second competing `redirect`).
93	+
94	+**Ask First:** none — scope is fully pinned by `epic-4-context.md` and stories 4.1–4.3's established conventions.
95	+
96	+**Never:** an update/delete method on `EntriesRepository`; a second sync-badge derivation path; a swipe/long-press gesture implying edit; a second `redirect`; a permission-denied-specific UI state.
97	+
98	+## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix
99	+
100	+| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
101	+|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
102	+| Tap a confirmed entry, online | valid real id | Fetches and renders content + source + time + Synchronized badge | N/A |
103	+| Tap entry, offline, already cached | id present in `entries` Hive box | Cached content renders via `getById`'s fallback | N/A |
104	+| Tap a nonexistent id or another user's id | backend `NOT_FOUND` | Generic not-found screen | Identical for both causes (RNF04) |
105	+| Tap a still-pending/failed placeholder card | synthetic `tempId`, unknown to backend | Same generic not-found screen | No special-casing |
106	+| Session expires while viewing detail | `SessionRepository.statusStream` emits expired | `ExpiryOverlayHost`'s existing overlay appears over the screen, no crash | N/A |

+---
+title: 'Story 4.4: Entry Detail View'
+type: 'feature'
+created: '2026-11-05'
+status: 'done'
+review_loop_iteration: 0
+context: []

+
+<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">
+
+## Intent
+
+**Problem:** `EntryRecordCard` has no `onTap` at all — a user cannot open a single Entry to see its full content, and `GET /entries/:id` (RF07) is wired nowhere in the app.
+
+**Approach:** Add `EntriesRepository.getById`, a new `EntryDetailCubit`/`EntryDetailScreen` reached via a `/meus-registros/:id` route, and wire the record card's new `onTap` into it. The cubit composes auth status, the one shared sync-badge derivation, and the fetched Entry into its own sealed state — strictly read-only, no prototype precedent to match.
+
+## Boundaries & Constraints
+
+**Always:**
+- `EntriesRepository.getById(String id)` returns `Either<Failure, Entry>` — the repository's third and last method; `create`/`list` unchanged (AD-11: create+read only, forever).
+- Real call: `ApiClient.get('entries-get', pathParams: [id])`; decode with `EntryDto.fromJson` (its response is a superset, same as `create`/`list`'s DTO reuse).
+- `getById` persists the fetched entry to the `entries` Hive box (`put`) before returning `Right`, same "persist then return" ordering `create`/`list` already use. On `Failure.networkOffline`/`networkTimeout` specifically, falls back to `entriesBox.get(id)` if present; a cache miss propagates the original failure unchanged (no synthesized not-found).
+- `Failure.notFound` (and any other failure the cache doesn't absorb) renders one generic not-found treatment — identical whether the id never existed or belongs to another user (RNF04); never a distinguishable permission-denied state.
+- New `EntryDetailCubit` (factory-registered, mirrors the capture cubits' DI shape) combines exactly three sources into its own sealed `EntryDetailState` (mirrors `MeusRegistrosState`'s shape, never `Resource<T>`): `SessionRepository.statusStream`, `PendingEntryWriteTracker` feeding the existing `deriveSyncBadgeState()` (never recomputed inline), and one `getById` fetch — merged only inside this cubit; it never imports/reaches into `MeusRegistrosCubit` or any other Cubit (AD-7).
+- Screen renders content, source, local time, and a `SyncBadge` (no `onRetryTap` — a fetched Entry is always server-confirmed) — zero edit affordance anywhere on it.
+- `EntryRecordCard` gains a required `onTap`; `MeusRegistrosScreen` wires it to `context.push('${AppRoutePaths.meusRegistros}/${entry.id}')`. A pending/failed placeholder's synthetic `tempId` is a valid, un-special-cased navigation target — it simply 404s into the same generic not-found treatment as any other unknown id (RNF04 already covers this).
+- New `GoRoute` nested under `AppRoutePaths.meusRegistros` with a required `:id` segment; reuses the app's single `redirect` and `ExpiryOverlayHost` as-is (no new overlay, no second competing `redirect`).
+
+**Ask First:** none — scope is fully pinned by `epic-4-context.md` and stories 4.1–4.3's established conventions.
+
+**Never:** an update/delete method on `EntriesRepository`; a second sync-badge derivation path; a swipe/long-press gesture implying edit; a second `redirect`; a permission-denied-specific UI state.
+
+## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix
+
+| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
+|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
+| Tap a confirmed entry, online | valid real id | Fetches and renders content + source + time + Synchronized badge | N/A |
+| Tap entry, offline, already cached | id present in `entries` Hive box | Cached content renders via `getById`'s fallback | N/A |
+| Tap a nonexistent id or another user's id | backend `NOT_FOUND` | Generic not-found screen | Identical for both causes (RNF04) |
+| Tap a still-pending/failed placeholder card | synthetic `tempId`, unknown to backend | Same generic not-found screen | No special-casing |
+| Session expires while viewing detail | `SessionRepository.statusStream` emits expired | `ExpiryOverlayHost`'s existing overlay appears over the screen, no crash | N/A |
+
+</frozen-after-approval>
+
+## Code Map
+
+- `lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart` -- add `getById(String id)` to the abstract port
+- `lib/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart` -- add `get(String id)` calling `entries-get` via `ApiClient.get(pathParams: [id])`, decoding `EntryDto` from `json['data']`
+- `lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart:30-121` -- implement `getById`: remote call → `_entriesBox.put` → `right(_toEntry(dto))`; offline/timeout fallback reads `_entriesBox.get(id)`, mirroring `_offlineFallback()`'s malformed-cache guard
+- `lib/features/entries/domain/entities/sync_badge_state.dart:92-101` -- reuse `deriveSyncBadgeState()` as-is, no changes
+- `lib/features/auth/domain/repositories/session_repository.dart` -- `statusStream`/`currentStatus`, consumed read-only by the new cubit
+- `lib/features/entries/domain/services/pending_entry_write_tracker.dart` -- `pendingWrites` stream, consumed read-only
+- `lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/entry_detail_cubit.dart` (new) -- `EntryDetailCubit` + sealed `EntryDetailState` (Loading/Data/NotFound/Error), takes `(EntriesRepository, PendingEntryWriteTracker, SessionRepository)`, exposes `load(String id)`
+- `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/entry_detail_screen.dart` (new) -- minimal read-only `BlocBuilder<EntryDetailCubit, EntryDetailState>` screen
+- `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entry_record_card.dart:43-56` -- add required `onTap`, drop the "never tappable for navigation (4.4)" doc line
+- `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart` -- pass `onTap: () => context.push('${AppRoutePaths.meusRegistros}/${entry.id}')` to each card
+- `lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart:26-35,71-125` -- nested `GoRoute` under `meusRegistros` with `:id`, builder wires `sl<EntryDetailCubit>()..load(state.pathParameters['id']!)`
+- `lib/features/entries/entries_injection.dart` -- `sl.registerFactory<EntryDetailCubit>(...)`, deps: `sl<EntriesRepository>()`, `sl<PendingEntryWriteTracker>()`, `sl<SessionRepository>()`
+- `test/features/entries/data/{datasources,repositories}/*` -- extend existing `entries_remote_data_source_test.dart`/`entries_repository_impl_test.dart` for `get`/`getById` (success, offline-cache-hit, offline-cache-miss, not-found)
+- `test/features/entries/presentation/cubit/entry_detail_cubit_test.dart` (new) -- covers the matrix above
+- `test/features/entries/presentation/screens/entry_detail_screen_test.dart` (new) -- renders each `EntryDetailState` variant

+- `test/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen_test.dart` -- assert card tap navigates (`context.push`)
+- `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart` -- assert the new nested route resolves to `EntryDetailScreen`
+

+
+**Execution:**
+- [x] `entries_repository.dart` -- add `getById` port method
+- [x] `entries_remote_data_source.dart` -- add `get(id)` calling `entries-get`
+- [x] `entries_repository_impl.dart` -- implement `getById` with Hive write-through + offline-cache fallback
+- [x] `entry_detail_cubit.dart` -- new cubit + sealed state, three-source composition
+- [x] `entry_detail_screen.dart` -- new read-only screen

+- [x] Tests listed in Code Map for each new/changed file above, including the full I/O matrix

+**Acceptance Criteria:**
+- [x] Given an Entry in the list, when I open it, then `GET /entries/:id` fetches and displays its full content with no edit affordance anywhere on the screen.
+- [x] Given an Entry that doesn't exist or belongs to another user, when the detail request is made, then the UI shows the same not-found treatment either way.
+- [x] Given this screen composes auth status, Sync Badge state, and Entry data, when those streams are combined, then they combine only through `EntryDetailCubit` — no BLoC in this feature imports another BLoC directly.
+
+## Verification
+
+**Commands:**
+- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
+- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass
+
+**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
+- Tap a confirmed entry's card in Meus Registros: detail screen shows its content and a Synchronized badge, no edit UI. Tap back; tap a never-existing id directly (e.g. via a temporarily hand-edited route) and confirm the generic not-found screen.

+- Entry point — the new port method, read+create only forever (AD-11).
+  [`entries_repository.dart:56`](../../lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart#L56)

+
+- `EntryDetailCubit` — merges `SessionRepository`, the tracker, and one fetch into its own state.

+
+- `EntryDetailScreen` — owns cubit disposal, switches on each state variant.

+/// composition, merged only here (AD-7: "it never imports/reaches into
+/// `MeusRegistrosCubit` or any other Cubit"):
+/// [SessionRepository.statusStream] (auth status — this cubit is the one
+/// documented compose point the Acceptance Criteria's third bullet names,
+/// even though nothing this screen renders branches on it today:
+/// `ExpiryOverlayHost`'s own independent subscription to the same stream,
+/// unchanged, is still what actually shows the session-expired overlay
+/// above this screen, Boundaries: "no new overlay"), [PendingEntryWrite
+/// Tracker.pendingWrites] feeding the one shared `deriveSyncBadgeState()`
+/// (never recomputed inline), and one [EntriesRepository.getById] fetch
+/// per [load] call.
+///
+/// A DI `factory` (Code Map) — unlike `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s
+/// `lazySingleton`, a fresh instance per visit to `/meus-registros/:id`
+/// matches this screen's single-fetch, throwaway lifecycle, mirroring the
+/// capture cubits' own factory shape (`capture_injection.dart`).
+class EntryDetailCubit extends Cubit<EntryDetailState> {
+  EntryDetailCubit(this._repository, this._tracker, this._sessionRepository)
+    : super(const EntryDetailLoading()) {
+    _pendingSubscription = _tracker.pendingWrites.listen(
+      (writes) => _pendingWrites = writes,
+    );
+    _sessionSubscription = _sessionRepository.statusStream.listen(
+      (status) => _sessionStatus = status,
+    );
+  }
+
+  final EntriesRepository _repository;
+  final PendingEntryWriteTracker _tracker;
+  final SessionRepository _sessionRepository;
+
+  late final StreamSubscription<List<PendingEntryWrite>> _pendingSubscription;
+  late final StreamSubscription<SessionStatus> _sessionSubscription;
+
+  /// Mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s own field of the same name — the
+  /// tracker's latest snapshot, read synchronously by [load]'s own badge
+  /// derivation rather than awaiting a fresh stream value.
+  List<PendingEntryWrite> _pendingWrites = const [];
+
+  /// The latest [SessionStatus] this cubit has observed off the composed
+  /// [SessionRepository.statusStream] — exposed purely so a test can
+  /// assert this cubit (not `EntryDetailScreen` itself) is the one
+  /// composition point for auth status alongside Entry/badge data
+  /// (Acceptance Criteria's third bullet, AD-7); never read by
+  /// `EntryDetailScreen`, which renders only from [state].
+  SessionStatus? get sessionStatus => _sessionStatus;
+  SessionStatus? _sessionStatus;
+
+  /// Guards a stale in-flight [load] call's result landing after a newer
+  /// one (e.g. a quick back-then-forward re-navigation) — same rationale
+  /// and shape as `MeusRegistrosCubit._generation`.
+  int _generation = 0;
+
+  /// `EntryDetailScreen`'s one driver, called from the `GoRoute.builder`
+  /// cascade (Code Map: `sl<EntryDetailCubit>()..load(...)`) — [id] is
+  /// either a real server id or a still-pending/failed placeholder's
+  /// synthetic `tempId` (Boundaries: "un-special-cased navigation target");
+  /// both are simply passed straight through to [EntriesRepository.
+  /// getById] with no branching here.
+  Future<void> load(String id) async {
+    final generation = ++_generation;
+    emit(const EntryDetailLoading());
+    final result = await _repository.getById(id);
+    if (isClosed || generation != _generation) {
+      return;
+    }
+    result.match(
+      (failure) {
+        if (failure is NotFound) {
+          emit(const EntryDetailNotFound());
+          return;
+        }
+        // Boundaries: every other non-absorbed Failure renders the exact
+        // same generic not-found treatment `EntryDetailScreen` gives
+        // EntryDetailNotFound — kept as its own state only for a test's

+        emit(EntryDetailError(message: failure.message));

+      },
+    );
+  }

+  @override

+    await _sessionSubscription.cancel();

The self-documented follow-up question is left unanswered.
  
  - `lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart` constructs and immediately drives the new cubit inside the `GoRoute.builder` closure itself: `sl<EntryDetailCubit>()..load(state.pathParameters['id']!)`. The app's router uses a shared `refreshListenable` (`_GoRouterRefreshStream` composing vault+session status, confirmed at `app_router.dart:82`) to re-run `_redirect` on auth/vault changes. If that refresh causes GoRouter to re-invoke the matched route's `builder` while the user is sitting on `/meus-registros/:id` (not just on first navigation), this line creates a brand-new `EntryDetailCubit` and fires a brand-new network fetch on every such refresh — unlike `MeusRegistrosScreen`'s `lazySingleton`-based builder, which is idempotent across rebuilds.
  
  - Following from the point above: `EntryDetailScreen`/`_EntryDetailBody` (`lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/entry_detail_screen.dart`) has no explicit `key` tied to the cubit instance and no `didUpdateWidget` override. If `builder` does hand it a new `cubit` value on a rebuild (per the previous point), Flutter's element diffing would update `_EntryDetailBodyState.widget.cubit` in place rather than calling `initState`/`dispose` again — `dispose()` (which closes the cubit) only fires when the widget leaves the tree. The *old* `EntryDetailCubit`, including its two live `StreamSubscription`s (`_pendingSubscription`, `_sessionSubscription`), would then never be closed — a subscription leak compounding with the redundant fetch above. Worth verifying against actual GoRouter rebuild semantics, but the code has no safeguard either way.
  
  - `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entry_record_card.dart`'s new `InkWell`/`onTap` (wired from `MeusRegistrosScreen` to `context.push(...)`) has no debounce/in-flight guard, so a rapid double-tap on a card can push `/meus-registros/:id` twice, stacking two detail-route instances. This is the same category of bug this diff's own `deferred-work.md` entry flags for the Insertion Modal's "Criar primeiro registro" CTA (`meus_registros_screen.dart:176`) and the pre-existing Home/Chat FAB — but the new navigation tap target introduced by this very diff isn't mentioned anywhere in that deferred list.

Extracting the path constants into their own file (e.g. `app_route_paths.dart`) would avoid both the cycle and the coupling.

The doc doesn't mention the encoding, so a future reader of the widget's own documentation would get a subtly wrong picture of what's sent.
  
  - `EntryDetailCubit.load()` (`entry_detail_cubit.dart`) computes `matchingPending`/`deriveSyncBadgeState()` only once, synchronously, at fetch-resolution time, from whatever `_pendingWrites` happens to hold at that instant. A user drilling into one entry loses the visual source cue they just saw in the list.

# Step 3: Triage

## RULES

- YOU MUST ALWAYS SPEAK OUTPUT in your Agent communication style with the config `{communication_language}`

## INSTRUCTIONS

1. **Normalize** findings from all layers into a unified list where each finding has:
   - `id` -- sequential integer
   - `source` -- the `id` of the layer that produced the finding (e.g., `blind-hunter`), or merged sources joined with `+` (e.g., `blind-hunter+edge-case-hunter`)
   - `title` -- one-line summary
   - `detail` -- full description
   - `location` -- file and line reference (if available)

2. **Deduplicate.** Deduplicate only findings with the same claim and same required action. If two or more findings meet both conditions, merge them into one:
   - Use the most specific finding as the base (prefer findings with a precise location over prose-only findings).
   - Append any unique detail, reasoning, or location references from the other finding(s) into the surviving `detail` field.
   - Set `source` to the merged sources (e.g., `blind-hunter+edge-case-hunter`).

3. Then evaluate each remaining finding independently. Do not reject a finding because a related finding was rejected.

4. **Read the code before rating.** Before assigning severity, open the source at each finding's location and read enough surrounding code to judge reachability -- call sites, guards, and validation that live outside the diff hunk. Do not rate from the diff hunk alone. Severity reflects the real consequence at a real call site, not the worst theoretical reading.

5. **Assign severity** to each finding by consequence for the artifact's main consumer (software user, document reader, etc).
   Disregard any severity assigned by a reviewing subagent. Review subagents operate under by-design information asymmetry and do not have enough context to set final severity for this workflow.
   - `low` -- none or cosmetic
   - `medium` -- tolerable
   - `high` -- intolerable

6. **Route** each finding into exactly one triage bucket:
   - **decision_needed** -- There is an ambiguous choice that requires human input. The code cannot be correctly patched without knowing the user's intent. Only possible if `{review_mode}` = `"full"`.
   - **patch** -- Code issue that is fixable without human input. The correct fix is unambiguous.
   - **defer** -- Pre-existing issue not caused by the current change. Real but not actionable now.
   - **dismiss** -- Noise, false positive, or handled elsewhere.

   If `{review_mode}` = `"no-spec"` and a finding would otherwise be `decision_needed`, reclassify it as `patch` (if the fix is unambiguous) or `defer` (if not).

7. **Drop** all `dismiss` findings. Record the dismiss count for the summary.

8. If `{failed_layers}` is non-empty, report which layers failed before announcing results. If zero findings remain after dropping dismissed AND `{failed_layers}` is non-empty, warn the user that the review may be incomplete rather than announcing a clean review.

9. If zero findings remain after triage (all rejected or none raised): state "✅ Clean review — all layers passed." (Step 3 already warned if any review layers failed via `{failed_layers}`.)

## NEXT

Read fully and follow `./step-04-present.md`

123	        builder: (context, state) =>
124	            MeusRegistrosScreen(cubit: sl<MeusRegistrosCubit>()),
125	        routes: [
126	          // spec-4-4 (RF07) — `:id` is either a real server id or a
127	          // still-pending/failed placeholder's synthetic `tempId`
128	          // (Boundaries: "a valid, un-special-cased navigation target");
129	          // `EntryDetailCubit` itself decides nothing about which kind it
130	          // is, it just calls `getById` with it verbatim.
131	          GoRoute(
132	            path: ':id',
133	            builder: (context, state) => EntryDetailScreen(
134	              cubit: sl<EntryDetailCubit>()
135	                ..load(state.pathParameters['id']!),
136	            ),
137	          ),
138	        ],
139	      ),
140	      GoRoute(
141	        path: AppRoutePaths.planosDeAcao,
142	        builder: (context, state) => const ActionPlansPlaceholderScreen(),
143	      ),
144	      GoRoute(
145	        path: AppRoutePaths.configuracoes,
146	        builder: (context, state) =>
147	            AccountSettingsScreen(cubit: sl<AccountSettingsCubit>()),
148	      ),
149	    ],
150	  );
151	}
152	
153	/// I/O & Edge-Case Matrix:
154	/// - status not yet known (`null`) -> `/boot`, unless already there.
155	/// - `unauthenticated` -> `/auth`, unless already there.
156	/// - `authenticated`/`expired` -> leaves `/boot`/`/auth` for `/`; every
157	///   other location is left alone *except* `/reauth` while already
158	///   `authenticated` (bounced home below — `/reauth` is meant to be
159	///   reached only by the expiry overlay's own explicit navigation while
160	///   `expired`, code review Story 1.6) — a mid-session expiry never
161	///   navigates away (Story 1.5 behavior preserved), and the three
162	///   non-Home destinations stay reachable while `expired`.
163	///
164	/// AD-14: Epic 2's `VaultStatus` gate (RF03) is composed first, strictly
165	/// ahead of every `SessionStatus` check below — the vault gate overrides
166	/// any location whenever it isn't `unlocked`, and only once it is does the
167	/// rest of this function (unchanged from Story 1.6) ever run.
168	String? _redirect(
169	  VaultRepository vaultRepository,
170	  SessionRepository sessionRepository,
171	  GoRouterState state,
172	) {
173	  final location = state.matchedLocation;
174	
175	  // AD-14 — checked before SessionStatus, per Boundaries ("`_redirect`
176	  // checks `VaultStatus` before `SessionStatus`"). `VaultStatus.locked` is
177	  // the default from construction (never `null`), so this never waits on
178	  // an async warm-up the way the `status == null` boot check below does.
179	  if (vaultRepository.currentStatus != VaultStatus.unlocked) {
180	    return location == AppRoutePaths.vaultLock ? null : AppRoutePaths.vaultLock;
181	  }
182	
183	  final status = sessionRepository.currentStatus;
184	
185	  if (status == null) {
186	    return location == AppRoutePaths.boot ? null : AppRoutePaths.boot;
187	  }
188	
189	  if (status == SessionStatus.unauthenticated) {
190	    return location == AppRoutePaths.auth ? null : AppRoutePaths.auth;
191	  }
192	
193	  // status is authenticated or expired.
194	  // `vaultLock` is included here too: once the vault unlocks while this
195	  // location is still `/vault` (the normal cold-start path once
196	  // `authenticate()` succeeds), the same fall-through that already bounces
197	  // `/boot`/`/auth` to Home applies — `/vault` is never a valid resting
198	  // place once `VaultStatus.unlocked`.
199	  if (location == AppRoutePaths.boot ||
200	      location == AppRoutePaths.auth ||
201	      location == AppRoutePaths.vaultLock) {
202	    return AppRoutePaths.home;
203	  }
204	  // `/reauth` is a throwaway placeholder standing in for Epic 2's real
205	  // reauth flow; it should never be sitting open once the session is back
206	  // to fully `authenticated` (code review, Story 1.6).
207	  if (location == AppRoutePaths.reauth &&
208	      status == SessionStatus.authenticated) {
209	    return AppRoutePaths.home;
210	  }
211	  return null;
212	}
213	
214	/// Wraps [streams] as a single `Listenable` so `GoRouter`'s
215	/// `refreshListenable` can re-run [_redirect] on every emission from either
216	/// one — go_router 18.1.1 exports no `GoRouterRefreshStream` of its own
217	/// (Code Map), so this is that small local class. Extended by AD-14 to
218	/// subscribe to both the vault and the session streams (previously just
219	/// the one session stream), composing them into the one `Listenable`
220	/// `GoRouter` itself requires (Boundaries: "never a second
221	/// `GoRouter`/`redirect`").
222	class _GoRouterRefreshStream extends ChangeNotifier {
223	  _GoRouterRefreshStream(Iterable<Stream<dynamic>> streams) {
224	    _subscriptions = [
225	      for (final stream in streams)
226	        stream.listen(
227	          (_) => notifyListeners(),
228	          // Mirrors `ExpiryOverlayHost`'s and `SessionRepositoryImpl`'s own
229	          // subscriptions to this same stream — no current implementation
230	          // ever errors on it, but a future one that did must not surface
231	          // as an unhandled zone exception here specifically.
232	          onError: (_, _) {},
233	        ),
234	    ];
235	  }
236	
237	  late final List<StreamSubscription<dynamic>> _subscriptions;
238	
239	  @override
240	  void dispose() {
241	    for (final subscription in _subscriptions) {
242	      subscription.cancel();
243	    }
244	    super.dispose();
245	  }
246	}

# Test Automation Summary

## Scope

Story 4.3 (empty-state handling) is presentation-only (spec-4-3's own
Intent/Boundaries): it rebuilds `_EmptyState`'s markup and wires its new
CTA to `InsertionModal.show()` — the identical call shape
`placeholder_screens.dart`'s Home/Chat FAB already uses — with no
`MeusRegistrosCubit`/`MeusRegistrosState`/repository change.

That means this story introduces no new real-pipeline (network/disk)
surface to cover:

- The CTA's own behavior (icon/copy/button render; tap opens the
  Insertion Modal; the malformed-`occurredAt` fallback still renders the
  same empty state) is pure widget/UI behavior, already covered against
  fakes in `meus_registros_screen_test.dart` (`zero entries renders the
  dedicated empty state...`, `tapping the empty-state CTA opens the
  Insertion Modal...`, `entries with every occurredAt malformed render the
  same dedicated empty state...`). No device/simulator exists yet
  (AGENTS.md), so there's no screen-tap E2E tier above this one — same
  policy the spec-4-2 run documented.
- The one behavior this story depends on that *is* real-pipeline —
  capturing from the empty-state-opened modal driving
  `MeusRegistrosEmpty` -> `MeusRegistrosLoaded` through the real
  `PendingEntryWriteTracker` -> `EntriesRepositoryImpl` -> real
  `Dio`/interceptors -> real `entries` Hive box — is already proven by
  `pending_write_sync_e2e_test.dart`'s happy-path test (spec-4-2's run),
  which starts from a genuine `MeusRegistrosEmpty` state and asserts the
  transition to `MeusRegistrosLoaded` via `tracker.create()`. Spec-4-3's
  CTA reaches that exact tracker call through the exact same modal/cubit
  wiring the FAB does — nothing about *how* the write reaches the tracker
  changed, so re-deriving that pipeline proof under a different entry
  point would duplicate existing coverage, not extend it.

Conclusion: no new E2E (or API) test file for this run. Verified the
existing suite still holds the line instead.

## Generated Tests

None — see Scope. No gap in real-pipeline coverage exists for this story.

## Verification

- `fvm flutter analyze` — zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` — 679/679 passed (unchanged from the spec-4-2 run's
  count — confirms no coverage drift).

## Coverage

- `entries.list`/`entries.create`/retry real-pipeline coverage remains in
  `entries_list_flow_e2e_test.dart` and `pending_write_sync_e2e_test.dart`
  (prior runs) — untouched and still green.
- Spec-4-3's own UI surface (empty-state render, CTA-opens-modal,
  malformed-fallback) is covered in `meus_registros_screen_test.dart`
  against fakes, per this project's no-device-E2E-for-UI-taps convention.

## Next Steps

- Story 4.4 (entry detail view) is next in delivery order (backlog) — once
  implemented, re-run this workflow to check whether it opens a new
  real-pipeline surface (e.g. a dedicated fetch-by-id call) worth an E2E
  test, the way 4.1/4.2 did and 4.3 did not.
- If a device/simulator or CI step is introduced (AGENTS.md notes none
  exists yet), consider promoting the existing real-pipeline `test()`
  suites into `integration_test/` driver tests against a real target.

1	import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
2	import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
3	
4	import '../../../../core/design_tokens.dart';
5	import '../../../../core/widgets/back_arrow_header.dart';
6	import '../../domain/entities/entry.dart';
7	import '../cubit/entry_detail_cubit.dart';
8	import '../cubit/entry_detail_state.dart';
9	import '../widgets/sync_badge.dart';
10	
11	/// `/meus-registros/:id`'s screen (spec-4-4) — strictly read-only: content,
12	/// source, local time, and a `SyncBadge` with no `onRetryTap` (a fetched
13	/// Entry is always server-confirmed, Boundaries) — zero edit affordance
14	/// anywhere. This screen has no prototype precedent to match (Intent), so
15	/// its layout is a plain reuse of existing tokens rather than a ported
16	/// `cerne-prototype.html` block.
17	///
18	/// [cubit] is a DI `factory` (Code Map), already constructed *and* loading
19	/// by the time this widget is built (`app_router.dart`'s own `GoRoute.
20	/// builder` cascade — it resolves a fresh `EntryDetailCubit` from `sl` and
21	/// immediately calls `load(id)` on it) — this `StatefulWidget`'s only job
22	/// over that is owning its disposal: unlike
23	/// `MeusRegistrosScreen`'s shared `lazySingleton` (never closed by the
24	/// screen), each visit to this route gets its own throwaway instance, so
25	/// [dispose] closes it.
26	class EntryDetailScreen extends StatelessWidget {
27	  const EntryDetailScreen({required this.cubit, super.key});
28	
29	  final EntryDetailCubit cubit;
30	
31	  @override
32	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
33	    return BlocProvider.value(
34	      value: cubit,
35	      child: _EntryDetailBody(cubit: cubit),
36	    );
37	  }
38	}
39	
40	/// Split out of [EntryDetailScreen] (a `StatelessWidget`, so it can't own
41	/// `State.dispose` itself) purely to close [cubit] once this route is
42	/// popped — the one disposal responsibility `MeusRegistrosScreen`'s own
43	/// shared-singleton cubit never needs.
44	class _EntryDetailBody extends StatefulWidget {
45	  const _EntryDetailBody({required this.cubit});
46	
47	  final EntryDetailCubit cubit;
48	
49	  @override
50	  State<_EntryDetailBody> createState() => _EntryDetailBodyState();
51	}
52	
53	class _EntryDetailBodyState extends State<_EntryDetailBody> {
54	  @override
55	  void dispose() {
56	    widget.cubit.close();
57	    super.dispose();
58	  }
59	
60	  @override
61	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
62	    return Scaffold(
63	      backgroundColor: DesignTokens.colorSurfaceBg,
64	      body: Column(
65	        children: [
66	          const BackArrowHeader(title: 'Registro'),
67	          Expanded(
68	            child: BlocBuilder<EntryDetailCubit, EntryDetailState>(
69	              builder: (context, state) => switch (state) {
70	                EntryDetailLoading() => const SizedBox.shrink(),
71	                EntryDetailData() => _DetailView(state: state),
72	                EntryDetailNotFound() => const _NotFoundView(),
73	                EntryDetailError() => const _NotFoundView(),
74	              },
75	            ),
76	          ),
77	        ],
78	      ),
79	    );
80	  }
81	}
82	
83	/// One source's own Portuguese label — reuses the exact same `EntrySource`
84	/// keys `entry_record_card.dart`'s own `_sourceMeta` map does, "Texto"
85	/// matching `insertion_modal.dart`'s own tab label for a manually-typed
86	/// entry (Design Notes: no prototype precedent gives this screen its own
87	/// label set, so the existing capture-tab vocabulary is reused rather than
88	/// inventing a new one).
89	const _sourceLabel = <EntrySource, String>{
90	  EntrySource.manual: 'Texto',
91	  EntrySource.audio: 'Áudio',
92	  EntrySource.photo: 'Foto',
93	  EntrySource.chat: 'Chat',
94	};
95	
96	class _DetailView extends StatelessWidget {
97	  const _DetailView({required this.state});
98	
99	  final EntryDetailData state;
100	
101	  @override
102	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
103	    final entry = state.entry;
104	    final sourceLabel = _sourceLabel[entry.source] ?? '';
105	    final time = _formatLocalDateTime(entry.occurredAt);
106	
107	    return SingleChildScrollView(
108	      padding: DesignTokens.screenPadding,
109	      child: Column(
110	        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
111	        children: [
112	          Row(
113	            children: [
114	              Text(
115	                sourceLabel,
116	                style: DesignTokens.textLabelMd.copyWith(
117	                  color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary,
118	                ),
119	              ),
120	              const SizedBox(width: DesignTokens.spacingSm),
121	              Text(
122	                time,
123	                style: DesignTokens.textMonoCaption.copyWith(
124	                  color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary,
125	                ),
126	              ),
127	            ],
128	          ),
129	          const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingMd),
130	          Text(
131	            entry.content,
132	            style: DesignTokens.textBodyLg.copyWith(
133	              color: DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary,
134	            ),
135	          ),
136	          const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingMd),
137	          // No `onRetryTap` (Boundaries) — a fetched Entry is always
138	          // server-confirmed, so this badge is purely informational here.
139	          SyncBadge(state: state.badgeState),
140	        ],
141	      ),
142	    );
143	  }
144	}
145	
146	/// RNF04 — the one generic treatment both `EntryDetailNotFound` and
147	/// `EntryDetailError` render (entry_detail_state.dart's own doc): identical
148	/// whether the id never existed, belongs to another user, or any other
149	/// non-absorbed `Failure` occurred — never a distinguishable
150	/// permission-denied (or failure-reason) state.
151	class _NotFoundView extends StatelessWidget {
152	  const _NotFoundView();
153	
154	  @override
155	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
156	    return Center(
157	      child: Padding(
158	        padding: DesignTokens.screenPadding,
159	        child: Column(
160	          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
161	          children: [
162	            const Icon(
163	              Icons.search_off,
164	              size: DesignTokens.entriesEmptyStateIconSize,
165	              color: DesignTokens.colorBorder,
166	            ),
167	            const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingMd),
168	            Text(
169	              'Registro não encontrado',
170	              style: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(
171	                color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary,
172	              ),
173	            ),
174	          ],
175	        ),
176	      ),
177	    );
178	  }
179	}
180	
181	/// [Entry.occurredAt]'s local wall-clock date+time, `dd/mm/yyyy HH:mm` —
182	/// this screen's own detail-level format (distinct from `EntryRecordCard`'s
183	/// list-level `HH:mm`-only `_formatTime`, since a full date is only useful
184	/// once a single entry is in full view). A malformed [occurredAt] falls
185	/// back to a placeholder instead of throwing (RNF09), same rationale
186	/// `_formatTime` already documents.
187	String _formatLocalDateTime(String occurredAt) {
188	  final local = DateTime.tryParse(occurredAt)?.toLocal();
189	  if (local == null) {
190	    return '--/--/---- --:--';
191	  }
192	  final day = local.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
193	  final month = local.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
194	  final hour = local.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
195	  final minute = local.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
196	  return '$day/$month/${local.year} $hour:$minute';
197	}

### Review Findings

- [ ] [Review][Decision] `EntryDetailCubit` tracks `SessionStatus` as a plain side field (`_sessionStatus`/`sessionStatus` getter), never folded into the sealed `EntryDetailState` — a textual deviation from the frozen Boundaries' "combines exactly three sources into its own sealed `EntryDetailState` ... merged only inside this cubit," even though `ExpiryOverlayHost`'s own independent, pre-existing mechanism still renders the session-expired overlay correctly and no behavior is observably wrong. [entry_detail_cubit.dart:31-39] — needs a decision: amend the implementation to literally fold session status into the sealed state (mechanical but touches every state variant), or accept the current side-field composition as satisfying the Acceptance Criteria's intent and relax/clarify the Boundaries wording instead.
- [ ] [Review][Patch] The new `getById`/`entries-get` real-pipeline surface (`EntriesRepositoryImpl.getById` → `EntriesRemoteDataSource.get` → real `Dio`/Hive) has no E2E test, and `tests/test-summary.md` was never updated for story 4.4 at all — it still only documents story 4.3's scope, leaving its own self-posed "Next Steps" question ("once implemented, re-run this workflow to check whether it opens a new real-pipeline surface... worth an E2E test, the way 4.1/4.2 did") unanswered. - [ ] [Review][Patch] `EntryRecordCard`'s new `onTap` (wired to `context.push` in `MeusRegistrosScreen`) has no debounce/in-flight guard — a rapid double-tap on a card can push `/meus-registros/:id` twice, stacking two detail-route instances. [entry_record_card.dart:104], [meus_registros_screen.dart:118]
- [ ] [Review][Patch] `meus_registros_screen.dart` newly imports `app_router.dart` solely to reach `AppRoutePaths.meusRegistros`, creating an import cycle with the router file that already imports this screen to build its route — extracting route-path constants into their own file would avoid it. [meus_registros_screen.dart:9]
- [ ] [Review][Patch] `EntryRecordCard`'s `onTap` doc comment describes the navigation call as `context.push('${AppRoutePaths.meusRegistros}/${entry.id}')` but the actual call in `meus_registros_screen.dart` wraps the id in `Uri.encodeComponent` — the doc doesn't mention the encoding. - [ ] [Review][Patch] `EntryDetailCubit.sessionStatus` is a public getter that exists, per its own doc comment, purely so a test can assert composition — it should be `@visibleForTesting` rather than plain public API. [entry_detail_cubit.dart] (sessionStatus getter)
- [ ] [Review][Patch] No widget test taps specifically inside the card's spine-strip region to guard the round-1 "tappable area must cover the whole card, spine included" fix against regression — the existing tap test only hits the content text. [entry_record_card_test.dart:136]
- [ ] [Review][Patch] The new nested `/meus-registros/:id` route has no test asserting the shared auth redirect still gates it while `unauthenticated`/`expired` — only the authenticated happy path is covered. [app_router_test.dart:508-527]
- [ ] [Review][Patch] No test covers `SessionRepository.statusStream` emitting `expired` while the `getById` fetch is still in flight — only the already-resolved-state ordering is tested. [entry_detail_cubit_test.dart:294-308]
- [x] [Review][Defer] `_tracker.pendingWrites`/`_sessionRepository.statusStream.listen(...)` in `EntryDetailCubit` have no `onError` handler — deferred, pre-existing: `MeusRegistrosCubit` subscribes to the same tracker stream the identical way, and `app_router.dart`'s own `_GoRouterRefreshStream` comment already documents that no current implementation of these streams ever errors; not a pattern introduced by this story.

1	# Test Automation Summary
2	
3	## Scope
4	
5	Story 4.3 (empty-state handling) is presentation-only (spec-4-3's own
6	Intent/Boundaries): it rebuilds `_EmptyState`'s markup and wires its new
7	CTA to `InsertionModal.show()` — the identical call shape
8	`placeholder_screens.dart`'s Home/Chat FAB already uses — with no
9	`MeusRegistrosCubit`/`MeusRegistrosState`/repository change.
10	
11	That means this story introduces no new real-pipeline (network/disk)
12	surface to cover:
13	
14	- The CTA's own behavior (icon/copy/button render; tap opens the
15	  Insertion Modal; the malformed-`occurredAt` fallback still renders the
16	  same empty state) is pure widget/UI behavior, already covered against
17	  fakes in `meus_registros_screen_test.dart` (`zero entries renders the
18	  dedicated empty state...`, `tapping the empty-state CTA opens the
19	  Insertion Modal...`, `entries with every occurredAt malformed render the
20	  same dedicated empty state...`). No device/simulator exists yet
21	  (AGENTS.md), so there's no screen-tap E2E tier above this one — same

# Test Automation Summary

## Scope

Story 4.3 (empty-state handling) is presentation-only (spec-4-3's own
Intent/Boundaries): it rebuilds `_EmptyState`'s markup and wires its new
CTA to `InsertionModal.show()` — the identical call shape
`placeholder_screens.dart`'s Home/Chat FAB already uses — with no
`MeusRegistrosCubit`/`MeusRegistrosState`/repository change.

That means this story introduces no new real-pipeline (network/disk)
surface to cover:

- The CTA's own behavior (icon/copy/button render; tap opens the
  Insertion Modal; the malformed-`occurredAt` fallback still renders the
  same empty state) is pure widget/UI behavior, already covered against
  fakes in `meus_registros_screen_test.dart` (`zero entries renders the
  dedicated empty state...`, `tapping the empty-state CTA opens the
  Insertion Modal...`, `entries with every occurredAt malformed render the
  same dedicated empty state...`). No device/simulator exists yet
  (AGENTS.md), so there's no screen-tap E2E tier above this one — same
  policy the spec-4-2 run documented.
- The one behavior this story depends on that *is* real-pipeline —
  capturing from the empty-state-opened modal driving
  `MeusRegistrosEmpty` -> `MeusRegistrosLoaded` through the real
  `PendingEntryWriteTracker` -> `EntriesRepositoryImpl` -> real
  `Dio`/interceptors -> real `entries` Hive box — is already proven by
  `pending_write_sync_e2e_test.dart`'s happy-path test (spec-4-2's run),
  which starts from a genuine `MeusRegistrosEmpty` state and asserts the
  transition to `MeusRegistrosLoaded` via `tracker.create()`. Spec-4-3's
  CTA reaches that exact tracker call through the exact same modal/cubit
  wiring the FAB does — nothing about *how* the write reaches the tracker
  changed, so re-deriving that pipeline proof under a different entry
  point would duplicate existing coverage, not extend it.

Conclusion: no new E2E (or API) test file for this run. Verified the
existing suite still holds the line instead.

## Generated Tests

None — see Scope. No gap in real-pipeline coverage exists for this story.

## Verification

- `fvm flutter analyze` — zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` — 679/679 passed (unchanged from the spec-4-2 run's
  count — confirms no coverage drift).

## Coverage

- `entries.list`/`entries.create`/retry real-pipeline coverage remains in
  `entries_list_flow_e2e_test.dart` and `pending_write_sync_e2e_test.dart`
  (prior runs) — untouched and still green.
- Spec-4-3's own UI surface (empty-state render, CTA-opens-modal,
  malformed-fallback) is covered in `meus_registros_screen_test.dart`
  against fakes, per this project's no-device-E2E-for-UI-taps convention.

## Next Steps

- Story 4.4 (entry detail view) is next in delivery order (backlog) — once
  implemented, re-run this workflow to check whether it opens a new
  real-pipeline surface (e.g. a dedicated fetch-by-id call) worth an E2E
  test, the way 4.1/4.2 did and 4.3 did not.
- If a device/simulator or CI step is introduced (AGENTS.md notes none
  exists yet), consider promoting the existing real-pipeline `test()`
  suites into `integration_test/` driver tests against a real target.

# Test Automation Summary

## Scope

Story 4.4 (entry detail view) adds `EntriesRepository.getById` — the
repository's third and last method (AD-11) — reached through a new
`EntriesRemoteDataSource.get` -> `ApiClient` -> real `Dio`/interceptors ->
real `entries` Hive box path, exactly the kind of new real-pipeline
surface the prior (spec-4-3) run's own "Next Steps" flagged for this story
to re-check.

Review findings (round 2) also added/changed coverage beyond the story's
own scope:

- `EntryDetailCubit`'s `SessionStatus` composition was restructured to
  fold into the sealed `EntryDetailState` itself (previously a side
  field) — covered by new/updated tests in `entry_detail_cubit_test.dart`,
  including a case where the session expires while a `getById` fetch is
  still in flight (previously untested).
- A debounce guard on `EntryRecordCard`'s new `onTap` (a rapid double-tap
  could stack two pushes of the same detail route) — covered by a new
  widget test in `meus_registros_screen_test.dart`.
- A widget test asserting a tap landing specifically inside the card's
  colored spine strip (not just the content text) still calls `onTap` —
  guards the round-1 "whole-card tappable area" fix against regression.
- Two new `app_router_test.dart` cases proving the nested
  `/meus-registros/:id` route is gated by the shared `_redirect` the same
  as any other destination: bounced to `/auth` while `unauthenticated`,
  and never navigated away from while `expired` mid-session.

## Generated Tests

### E2E Tests

- [x] `test/features/entries/entry_detail_flow_e2e_test.dart` — drives the
  real DI-resolved `EntriesRepository.getById` through real
  `Dio`/interceptors and a real `entries` Hive box, answering the prior
  run's own open question:
  - Happy path: `getById()` fires one real GET to `entries-get/{id}` with
    the right URL/headers/body, resolves `Right`, and persists to the real
    Hive box.
  - Offline fallback: a `NETWORK_OFFLINE` response is genuinely retried
    `RetryInterceptor.maxRetries` times over the real retry pipeline
    before falling back to a real cached entry in the Hive box.
  - Not-found: a genuine `NOT_FOUND` response propagates as `Left` with no
    retry and no synthesized cache fallback.

### Other new/updated tests (unit + widget)

- `entry_detail_cubit_test.dart` — `SessionStatus` folded into
  `EntryDetailState`: stamped on the first emit, re-stamped on a later
  status change without disturbing resolved entry/badge data, and stamped
  correctly when the status changes mid-flight (before `getById`
  resolves).
- `entry_record_card_test.dart` — a tap inside the spine strip's own
  bounds calls `onTap`.
- `meus_registros_screen_test.dart` — a rapid double-tap on a card pushes
  the detail route only once.
- `app_router_test.dart` — the nested `:id` route redirects to `/auth`
  while unauthenticated, and stays put through a mid-session expiry.

## Verification

- `fvm flutter analyze` — zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` — 721/721 passed (up from 679/679 in the spec-4-3
  run — 42 new tests: the 3 E2E cases above plus the round-2 review-fix
  unit/widget tests, with none removed).

## Coverage

- `entries.getById` (spec-4-4): success, offline-cache fallback, and
  not-found — all three real-pipeline paths now covered end-to-end, the
  same tier `entries.list`/`entries.create` already had.
- `entries.list`/`entries.create`/retry real-pipeline coverage remains in
  `entries_list_flow_e2e_test.dart` and `pending_write_sync_e2e_test.dart`
  (prior runs) — untouched and still green.
- `EntryDetailCubit`'s full I/O matrix (success, notFound, every other
  non-absorbed failure, offline/timeout cache fallback at the repository
  layer, the stale-generation guard, and now `SessionStatus` composition
  at every point in `load()`'s lifecycle) is covered against fakes in
  `entry_detail_cubit_test.dart`.
- Navigation wiring (card tap -> push, the nested route's own auth
  gating, debounce) is covered in `meus_registros_screen_test.dart`/
  `app_router_test.dart` against fakes, per this project's
  no-device-E2E-for-UI-taps convention.

## Next Steps

- Story 4.4 is the last story in Epic 4 (entries) — Epic 5 (search/
  filters) is next in delivery order; re-run this workflow once it's
  implemented to check whether it opens its own new real-pipeline surface
  worth an E2E test.
- If a device/simulator or CI step is introduced (AGENTS.md notes none
  exists yet), consider promoting the existing real-pipeline `test()`
  suites into `integration_test/` driver tests against a real target.

# Test Automation Summary

## Scope

Story 4.3 (empty-state handling) is presentation-only (spec-4-3's own
Intent/Boundaries): it rebuilds `_EmptyState`'s markup and wires its new
CTA to `InsertionModal.show()` — the identical call shape
`placeholder_screens.dart`'s Home/Chat FAB already uses — with no
`MeusRegistrosCubit`/`MeusRegistrosState`/repository change.

That means this story introduces no new real-pipeline (network/disk)
surface to cover:

- The CTA's own behavior (icon/copy/button render; tap opens the
  Insertion Modal; the malformed-`occurredAt` fallback still renders the
  same empty state) is pure widget/UI behavior, already covered against
  fakes in `meus_registros_screen_test.dart` (`zero entries renders the
  dedicated empty state...`, `tapping the empty-state CTA opens the
  Insertion Modal...`, `entries with every occurredAt malformed render the
  same dedicated empty state...`). No device/simulator exists yet
  (AGENTS.md), so there's no screen-tap E2E tier above this one — same
  policy the spec-4-2 run documented.
- The one behavior this story depends on that *is* real-pipeline —
  capturing from the empty-state-opened modal driving
  `MeusRegistrosEmpty` -> `MeusRegistrosLoaded` through the real
  `PendingEntryWriteTracker` -> `EntriesRepositoryImpl` -> real
  `Dio`/interceptors -> real `entries` Hive box — is already proven by
  `pending_write_sync_e2e_test.dart`'s happy-path test (spec-4-2's run),
  which starts from a genuine `MeusRegistrosEmpty` state and asserts the
  transition to `MeusRegistrosLoaded` via `tracker.create()`. Spec-4-3's
  CTA reaches that exact tracker call through the exact same modal/cubit
  wiring the FAB does — nothing about *how* the write reaches the tracker
  changed, so re-deriving that pipeline proof under a different entry
  point would duplicate existing coverage, not extend it.

Conclusion: no new E2E (or API) test file for this run. Verified the
existing suite still holds the line instead.

## Generated Tests

None — see Scope. No gap in real-pipeline coverage exists for this story.

## Verification

- `fvm flutter analyze` — zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` — 679/679 passed (unchanged from the spec-4-2 run's
  count — confirms no coverage drift).

## Coverage

- `entries.list`/`entries.create`/retry real-pipeline coverage remains in
  `entries_list_flow_e2e_test.dart` and `pending_write_sync_e2e_test.dart`
  (prior runs) — untouched and still green.
- Spec-4-3's own UI surface (empty-state render, CTA-opens-modal,
  malformed-fallback) is covered in `meus_registros_screen_test.dart`
  against fakes, per this project's no-device-E2E-for-UI-taps convention.

## Next Steps

- Story 4.4 (entry detail view) is next in delivery order (backlog) — once
  implemented, re-run this workflow to check whether it opens a new
  real-pipeline surface (e.g. a dedicated fetch-by-id call) worth an E2E
  test, the way 4.1/4.2 did and 4.3 did not.
- If a device/simulator or CI step is introduced (AGENTS.md notes none
  exists yet), consider promoting the existing real-pipeline `test()`
  suites into `integration_test/` driver tests against a real target.
